clauses.clause: Horde mix: ≥ 4 distinct infected looks in every 20-infected sample (not only suits).
clauses.note: Final original-six-role native routes: every war tick checks nearest20 living, nonhidden, admitted infected. Low10,679checks and high10,715checks; both reach only3 distinct looks. Low counterexample tick4328, high7580; exact20 identities/models and count distributions retained. Both final state hashes equal independent qa:accept controls. Local appearance balancing does not establish the four-look requirement. Added brute/armored trials were rejected because contact or mortal-route regressions outweighed their census gains. Whole row FAIL; no counts or stats reduced.
